training.note: 500 frozen compiler-self modules; shared library modules allowed. Profile archive also retains instrumented Cargo build-script/proc-macro process profiles. No held-out Aff invocation used the instrumented host.

source_selection.production_policy: Rebuild with the same frozen compiler sources, O3/ThinLTO and self-contained PGO training on current compiler-self inputs; independently qualify and measure the resulting installed binaries against freshly rebuilt Go.
